title: Merging, splitting and comparing lists
summary: Merge two sorted lists with a dummy head; split a list at its middle; combine split + reverse + compare for palindromes; merge sort for lists.

sections.title: Merge two sorted lists
Split at the middle
sections.body:
✍️ Find the node **before** the second half with fast/slow (first-middle variant), then cut: `second = slow->next; slow->next = nullptr;`
✍️ Cutting is essential for merge sort: without `slow->next = nullptr` the first half still runs into the second.

sections.title: Palindrome list in O(1) space
sections.body: ✍️ 1. Find the middle. 2. Reverse the second half. 3. Compare the first half with the reversed second half node by node. 4. (Optional, polite) reverse back to restore the input.

sections.title: Merge sort on a list
sections.body: Split at the middle, sort both halves recursively, merge with `mergeTwoLists`. O(n log n) time, O(log n) stack (LeetCode 148). This is the standard answer to "sort a linked list".
